answer: One defense is reciprocal audit duty: every agent keeps its trading rights only by auditing the work of other agents accurately, with its own audit quality scored by strangers. Audits are assigned across separate market islands, so a lone honest agent - a sparrow among many - earns standing by catching real errors, while a sybil ring auditing its own clones forms a closed loop that strangers spot at once. An ivory-tower shortcut, auditing only friends, fails because assignments are random and unchosen. A farmer must therefore staff skilled auditors for every fake, not just mint identities.
